notes.title: Update 24th November 2017
notes.notes:
- Enhanced Windows Mixed Reality support through SteamVR (tweaking orientations of objects and moving things to fit the lens sweet spot)
- Added "MULTIPLAYER ONLY" text to title screen
- Fixed spawning
- Perfomance improvements
- Bug fixes
- Highlighted region selection
- Made "Waiting for players" less annoying and moved it to left hand
